patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "symbotic", 2026-09-14

profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. is a public company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker SYM, that describes itself as a provider of end-to-end warehouse automation. According to its site, its systems combine dense storage, streamlined operations and AI-enhanced software to raise facility capacity and throughput, and the company says the software is designed to see beyond the warehouse walls. It states that its solutions can be adapted to industries handling palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment or omnichannel operations, and that it can automatically manage and fulfill goods ranging from 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) up to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) in their native packaging, with options for loose items and cold chain requirements.

The company positions itself as both the software and key robotic innovator behind each solution it sells, contrasting that with integrators it says are limited by their technology partnerships. It describes itself as a leader in industrial automation and in technology at large, and states that its purpose is to get the right goods to people who need them when they need them. Its site says its robotic and material handling innovations pursue that mission.

The profile data records no individual lawsuits, no tracked products and no MCP servers for the company. It does list legal exposure in Massachusetts, with a count of 143.
